description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'ShopEntity' that extends 'Entity' and implements 'Serializable'. It manages a 'language' property with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ShopEntity
classes.description: An abstract class representing a shop entity with multilingual support, extending 'Entity' and serializable for persistence.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language associated with the shop entity.
